findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_route_facts, get_mover_profile, check_mover_licence, search_moving_guides · Private data: find_movers, get_mover_profile, check_mover_licence · Public sink: request_moving_quotes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_route_facts, get_mover_profile, check_mover_licence, search_moving_guides · Private data: find_movers, get_mover_profile, check_mover_licence · Public sink: request_moving_quotes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
